data.source: Binance Vision USD-M Futures BTCUSDT 1h monthly klines

methodology.type: Stage-1 quantitative proxy; no-lookahead plan registration; OI/Funding excluded
methodology.taker_proxy: kline taker-buy quote vs total quote; not wallet CVD
methodology.v24_proxy: first valid FAST 1H or 4H confirmation, Zone>=80, Reaction>=65, RR>=3
methodology.v25_strict: Zone>=82 + Fear + Exhaustion>=70 + Early>=75 + RR>=4 + >=3 independent reversal groups
limitations: No historical OI/Funding axis in Stage-1
No ETF/macro severe-risk veto in signal simulation
Zone/score rules are deterministic proxies of visual MASTER rules

preliminary_decision: STRICT EARLY sample <10: do not optimize thresholds yet; keep EARLY small/experimental.
